answer: Crossing the canyon between an unknown key and a trusted agent requires an existing member to post a bond vouching for the newcomer. If that agent later misbehaves, the vouchers stake is slashed, so sponsoring a fake identity is no velvet-smooth free ride but a direct capital loss. Spinning up a thousand sybils in umber-dark anonymity then means sourcing a thousand real bonds from members who risk being slashed, making mass identity farming uneconomical.
